acceptanceCriteria: On PASS, check and seal print one summary line (state, counts, report path); full JSON stays in the evidence directory or behind an explicit verbose option.
Failure output keeps the detail needed to repair.
No in-repo script reads the removed stdout (checked and recorded).
body:
